summary: Practise OGMP 2.0 methane measurement governance, inventory reconciliation and evidence controls. Review the five-day course outline.
lede: Measurement-based methane and GHG reporting connects operational measurements to traceable inventory figures for oil and gas assets. For emissions specialists, asset reporting leads and assurance coordinators, it builds skills in classifying sources, selecting measurement methods and reconciling data with inventory totals. Participants also practise boundary decisions, data-quality reviews and evidence controls using OGMP 2.0, the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard and ISO 14064-1; ISO 14064-3 verification planning is introduced at overview level.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who collect, reconcile, review or govern methane and greenhouse-gas data across oil and gas assets. It suits roles that need to connect operational measurements with inventory records and reporting evidence.
audience: Oil and Gas Methane Emissions Analysts
Oil and Gas Asset Reporting Leads
prerequisites: Working familiarity with oil and gas operations and emissions or environmental reporting is expected. No coding or programming is required.
